en: |0⟩ → |+⟩, |1⟩ → |−⟩. Changes between the Z basis and the X basis.
Rotates by π/4 about the y axis: |0⟩ → cos(π/8)|0⟩ + sin(π/8)|1⟩.
Rotates by π/8 about the y axis: |0⟩ → cos(π/16)|0⟩ + sin(π/16)|1⟩.

zh: 控制位为 1 时翻转目标位。先点控制位，再点同一列的目标位。
en: Flips the target when the control is 1. Click the control first, then the target in the same column.

zh: 两个比特都为 1 时乘上 −1，两个比特的地位对称。先点一个比特，再点同一列的另一个。
en: Multiplies by −1 when both qubits are 1; the two qubits play symmetric roles. Click one qubit first, then the other in the same column.

zh: 在计算基下测量。测量之后这根线只携带经典的结果，只能当控制位。
en: Measures in the computational basis. After the measurement this wire carries only the classical result and can serve only as a control.

zh: 光子在这一刻经过上面那一路的炸弹。真炸弹：|1⟩ 分量引爆；哑弹：什么也不发生。
en: At this moment the photon passes the bomb on the upper path. Live bomb: the |1⟩ component sets it off; dud: nothing happens.

zh: 测量过的比特只携带经典的结果，只能当控制位。
en: A measured qubit carries only the classical result and can serve only as a control.
This wire has already been measured.

zh: Alice 和 Bob 相距很远。跨越两边的门只能由 Alice 已经测量过的比特控制。
en: Alice and Bob are far apart. A gate that spans both sides can be controlled only by a qubit Alice has already measured.

zh: 控制位必须是 Alice 测得的经典结果，Bob 的比特只能当目标。
en: The control must be Alice's classical measurement result; Bob's qubit can only be the target.

zh: |+⟩ 和 |−⟩ 在计算基下测出 0 和 1 的概率都是一半，二者只差一个相对相位。
en: |+⟩ and |−⟩ both give 0 and 1 with probability one half in the computational basis; they differ only by a relative phase.
H sends |0⟩ to |+⟩ and |1⟩ to |−⟩. Z sends |+⟩ to |−⟩.

zh: 两条两个门的路：先 X 再 H，或者先 H 再 Z。判定只看保真度 F = |⟨−|ψ⟩|²，所以整体相位不可观测：−|−⟩ 与 |−⟩ 是同一个物理态。相对相位却可以观测：|+⟩ 和 |−⟩ 在计算基下的统计完全一样，再加一个 H 就能百分之百地区分。
en: There are two routes with two gates: X then H, or H then Z. The judge looks only at the fidelity F = |⟨−|ψ⟩|², so a global phase is unobservable: −|−⟩ and |−⟩ are the same physical state. A relative phase, by contrast, is observable: |+⟩ and |−⟩ have exactly the same statistics in the computational basis, yet one more H tells them apart with certainty.

zh: 只用 H 和 Z，拼出一个与 X 门完全相同的操作。它必须对每个输入都成立，最多相差一个整体相位。
en: Using only H and Z, build an operation identical to the X gate. It must hold for every input, up to a global phase.

zh: Z 在 {|+⟩, |−⟩} 基下做的事，正是 X 在 {|0⟩, |1⟩} 基下做的事。
en: What Z does in the {|+⟩, |−⟩} basis is exactly what X does in the {|0⟩, |1⟩} basis.

zh: HZH = X。H 是 Z 基和 X 基之间的换基矩阵（而且 H = H⁻¹），所以用 H 共轭一个门，就是在另一组基里看它。同理 HXH = Z。判定计算的是 |Tr(X†U)|/2，它等于 1 当且仅当 U 与 X 只差一个整体相位。
en: HZH = X. H is the change-of-basis matrix between the Z basis and the X basis (and H = H⁻¹), so conjugating a gate by H means looking at it in the other basis. Likewise HXH = Z. The judge computes |Tr(X†U)|/2, which equals 1 exactly when U and X differ only by a global phase.

zh: 先让上面的比特进入叠加态，再用它去控制下面的比特。
en: First put the upper qubit into a superposition, then use it to control the lower one.

zh: H 之后两个比特仍是乘积态 |+⟩|0⟩；CNOT 之后就无法写成两个单比特态的乘积了。点电路上方的步骤号，对比 CNOT 前后的 Bloch 球：每个比特的 Bloch 向量从球面缩到了球心，单个比特的约化态变成了最大混合态 I/2，信息全部存在于两者的关联之中。⑮ Bell 游戏里分给 Alice 和 Bob 的，就是这样一对光子。
en: After H the two qubits are still in the product state |+⟩|0⟩; after CNOT the state can no longer be written as a product of two single-qubit states. Click the step numbers above the circuit and compare the Bloch spheres before and after CNOT: each qubit's Bloch vector shrinks from the surface to the center, the reduced state of a single qubit becomes the maximally mixed state I/2, and all the information sits in the correlation between the two. This is the kind of photon pair that Alice and Bob share in ⑮ Bell game.

zh: 两比特 · 算子恒等式
只用 CNOT 交换两个比特。必须对所有输入都成立，包括叠加态。
en: Swap two qubits using only CNOT. It must hold for every input, superpositions included.

zh: 经典程序里，a ^= b; b ^= a; a ^= b 可以不用临时变量交换两个数。
en: In a classical program, a ^= b; b ^= a; a ^= b swaps two numbers without a temporary variable.

zh: 方向交替的三个 CNOT 正是那个异或的技巧。门是线性的，所以在四个基矢上都对，就在一切叠加态上都对；判定检查的是整个 4×4 矩阵，包括各列之间的相对相位。
en: Three CNOTs of alternating direction are exactly that XOR trick. Gates are linear, so correct on the four basis vectors means correct on every superposition; the judge checks the whole 4×4 matrix, including the relative phases between its columns.

zh: 黑盒算法 · 相位回踢
黑盒 U_f 计算一个未知的函数 f: {0, 1} → {0, 1}，作用为 |x⟩|y⟩ ↦ |x⟩|y ⊕ f(x)⟩。它固定在第 3 列，只能用这一次。判断 f 是常数还是平衡的：常数时上面的比特测出 0，平衡时测出 1。四种 f 都必须判对。
en: The black box U_f computes an unknown function f: {0, 1} → {0, 1}, acting as |x⟩|y⟩ ↦ |x⟩|y ⊕ f(x)⟩. It is fixed in column 3 and can be used only this once. Decide whether f is constant or balanced: the upper qubit should measure 0 when f is constant and 1 when it is balanced. All four f must be decided correctly.

zh: 如果下面的比特处在 |−⟩，那么 y ⊕ f(x) 的效果等于给 |x⟩ 乘上相位 (−1)^f(x)。这叫相位回踢。
en: If the lower qubit is in |−⟩, then y ⊕ f(x) amounts to multiplying |x⟩ by the phase (−1)^f(x). This is called phase kickback.

zh: 让上面的比特以 |+⟩ 进入黑盒。
en: Let the upper qubit enter the black box as |+⟩.

zh: 经典的做法必须查询两次。量子的做法：|0⟩|1⟩ 经 H⊗H 变成 |+⟩|−⟩，黑盒之后上面的比特是 ±|+⟩（常数）或 ±|−⟩（平衡），再一个 H 就把两类完全分开。这是 Deutsch 1985 年的算法；Deutsch–Jozsa、Simon 和 Shor 的算法都沿用了同一个结构：叠加、查询、干涉。
en: A classical method must query twice. The quantum method: H⊗H turns |0⟩|1⟩ into |+⟩|−⟩; after the black box the upper qubit is ±|+⟩ (constant) or ±|−⟩ (balanced), and one more H separates the two classes completely. This is Deutsch's algorithm of 1985; the algorithms of Deutsch–Jozsa, Simon and Shor all keep the same structure: superpose, query, interfere.

zh: 测量 · 量子芝诺效应
这个比特表示光子走哪一路：|0⟩ 是下面那一路，|1⟩ 是上面那一路。上面那一路可能有一颗单个光子就能引爆的真炸弹，也可能是哑弹。炸弹门 B 表示光子在这一刻经过上面那一路。设计一个实验，让某个测量结果只可能在真炸弹时出现，并且尽量不引爆它。确认是真炸弹且没有爆炸的概率达到 25% 通关，50% 两星，70% 三星。
en: This qubit says which path the photon takes: |0⟩ is the lower path, |1⟩ the upper one. On the upper path there may be a live bomb that a single photon sets off, or a dud. The bomb gate B means the photon passes along the upper path at that moment. Design an experiment in which some measurement result can occur only with a live bomb, and set it off as rarely as possible. Confirming a live bomb without an explosion with probability 25% passes, 50% earns two stars, 70% three.

zh: H 就是分束器，H·B·H 就是一台 Mach–Zehnder 干涉仪。
en: H is a beam splitter, so H·B·H is a Mach–Zehnder interferometer.

zh: 想拿三星：每次只转一点点，每转一次就让炸弹"看"一次。哑弹时这些小的转动累积成一次完整的翻转；真炸弹时，每一次"看"都把光子拉回 |0⟩。
en: For three stars: rotate only a little each time, and after each rotation let the bomb "look" once. With a dud these small rotations add up to one full flip; with a live bomb, every "look" pulls the photon back to |0⟩.

zh: 这是 Elitzur 和 Vaidman 1993 年的无相互作用测量。干涉仪版本只有 25%。用 N 次 Ry(π/N)、每次之后放一个炸弹：哑弹时 N 次转动合成 Ry(π)，光子必然到 |1⟩；真炸弹时每次存活的概率是 cos²(π/2N)，总的存活概率约为 1 − π²/(4N)，N 越大越接近 1。这就是量子芝诺效应。Kwiat 等人 1995 年用光子做出了这个实验。⑰ 炸弹检测把它变成了一套玩法：光路会丢光子、步数有限，N 不能无限地加。
en: This is the interaction-free measurement of Elitzur and Vaidman (1993). The interferometer version reaches only 25%. Use N rotations Ry(π/N), each followed by a bomb: with a dud the N rotations combine to Ry(π) and the photon surely ends in |1⟩; with a live bomb each step survives with probability cos²(π/2N), and the total survival probability is about 1 − π²/(4N), approaching 1 as N grows. This is the quantum Zeno effect. Kwiat and colleagues carried out the experiment with photons in 1995. ⑰ Bomb testing turns it into a game: the loop loses photons and steps are limited, so N cannot grow without bound.

zh: 黑盒算法 · 振幅放大
黑盒 O 把四个基态中某一个未知的 |w⟩ 乘上 −1，其余不变。它固定在第 2 列，只能用这一次。让两个比特的测量结果百分之百等于 w，四种 w 都必须对。
en: The black box O multiplies one unknown basis state |w⟩ of the four by −1 and leaves the others alone. It is fixed in column 2 and can be used only this once. Make the measurement of the two qubits equal w with certainty, for all four w.

zh: 查询之前先做均匀叠加 |s⟩ = H⊗H|00⟩。查询之后，你需要关于 |s⟩ 的反射 2|s⟩⟨s| − I。
en: Before the query, create the uniform superposition |s⟩ = H⊗H|00⟩. After the query you need the reflection about |s⟩, 2|s⟩⟨s| − I.

zh: 用 H⊗H 夹住它，问题变成关于 |00⟩ 的反射 2|00⟩⟨00| − I = diag(1, −1, −1, −1)。试试 Z⊗Z 和 CZ 的乘积。
en: Sandwich it between H⊗H and the problem becomes the reflection about |00⟩, 2|00⟩⟨00| − I = diag(1, −1, −1, −1). Try the product of Z⊗Z and CZ.

zh: 经典的做法平均要查询 2.25 次，最坏 3 次。Grover 迭代每次把态在 |w⟩ 与其正交补张成的平面里转过 2θ，其中 sin θ = 1/√N。N = 4 时 θ = 30°，起点在 30°，一次迭代正好转到 90°，所以成功的概率恰好是 1。一般的 N 需要约 (π/4)√N 次，这是平方的加速，而且已经被证明是最优的。⑯ 量子搜索里 N 可以大到一百万：那时转几步再测、转过了头怎么办，就是要规则来决定的事了。
en: A classical method needs 2.25 queries on average and 3 at worst. Each Grover iteration rotates the state by 2θ in the plane spanned by |w⟩ and its orthogonal complement, where sin θ = 1/√N. For N = 4, θ = 30°: the start is at 30° and one iteration lands exactly at 90°, so the success probability is exactly 1. For general N about (π/4)√N iterations are needed, a quadratic speedup that has been proved optimal. In ⑯ Quantum search N can be as large as a million: then how many steps to rotate before measuring, and what to do after overshooting, is for the rule to decide.

zh: Alice 和 Bob 事先共享 |Φ⁺⟩，上面的比特归 Alice，下面的归 Bob。Alice 用编码门 E 把两位经典比特 b₁b₂ 写进她的粒子（00 → I，01 → X，10 → Z，11 → 先 X 后 Z），再把这一个粒子寄给 Bob。现在两个粒子都在 Bob 手里。设计解码电路，让测量结果（上，下）等于 b₁b₂，四种消息都要对。
en: Alice and Bob share |Φ⁺⟩ in advance; the upper qubit is Alice's, the lower one Bob's. With the encoding gate E, Alice writes two classical bits b₁b₂ into her particle (00 → I, 01 → X, 10 → Z, 11 → X then Z), then mails that single particle to Bob. Now both particles are in Bob's hands. Design a decoding circuit so that the measurement results (upper, lower) equal b₁b₂, for all four messages.

zh: Alice 的四种操作把 |Φ⁺⟩ 变成四个互相正交的 Bell 态。
en: Alice's four operations turn |Φ⁺⟩ into four mutually orthogonal Bell states.

zh: 把制备 Bell 态的电路倒过来跑。
en: Run the circuit that prepares a Bell state backwards.

zh: 只寄出一个量子比特，却传了两个经典比特，这是 Bennett 和 Wiesner 1992 年提出的超密编码。代价是事先共享的纠缠。没有纠缠时，Holevo 界保证一个量子比特最多只能携带一个经典比特。
en: Only one qubit is sent, yet two classical bits arrive: this is superdense coding, proposed by Bennett and Wiesner in 1992. The price is the entanglement shared in advance. Without entanglement, the Holevo bound guarantees that one qubit can carry at most one classical bit.

zh: 最上面的比特是一个未知的态 |ψ⟩，下面两个比特共享 |Φ⁺⟩：中间的归 Alice，最下面的归 Bob。把 |ψ⟩ 传到 Bob 的比特上。规定：Alice 和 Bob 相距很远，跨越两边的门只能由 Alice 已经测量过的比特控制，相当于打电话告诉 Bob 测量结果；测量过的比特只能当控制位。检验时会用 6 个不同的 |ψ⟩。
en: The top qubit is an unknown state |ψ⟩; the two qubits below share |Φ⁺⟩: the middle one is Alice's, the bottom one Bob's. Transfer |ψ⟩ to Bob's qubit. The rule: Alice and Bob are far apart, so a gate spanning both sides can be controlled only by a qubit Alice has already measured, which amounts to phoning Bob the result; a measured qubit can serve only as a control. The check uses 6 different |ψ⟩.

zh: 先在 Alice 一侧做 Bell 基测量：CNOT，再对最上面的比特做 H，然后测量这两个比特。
en: First make a Bell-basis measurement on Alice's side: CNOT, then H on the top qubit, then measure these two qubits.

zh: 四种测量结果对应 Bob 手里的四种状态，它们与 |ψ⟩ 只差 I、X、Z 或 ZX。用测量结果控制修正门。
en: The four measurement results correspond to four states in Bob's hands, which differ from |ψ⟩ only by I, X, Z or ZX. Use the measurement results to control the correcting gates.

zh: Bennett 等人 1993 年提出。没有超光速：在收到两位经典比特之前，Bob 的比特是最大混合态 I/2，你可以在 Bloch 球上看到它停在球心。|ψ⟩ 在 Alice 那里被测量破坏了，所以也不违反不可克隆定理。这里用延迟测量原理来模拟：测量之后只当控制位的比特，等价于把测量挪到最后。
en: Proposed by Bennett and colleagues in 1993. Nothing travels faster than light: until the two classical bits arrive, Bob's qubit is in the maximally mixed state I/2, and you can see it sitting at the center of the Bloch sphere. |ψ⟩ is destroyed by the measurement on Alice's side, so the no-cloning theorem is not violated either. The simulation here uses the principle of deferred measurement: a qubit used only as a control after being measured is equivalent to moving the measurement to the end.

zh: 非定域性 · Bell 不等式
裁判随机给 Alice 一个比特 x、给 Bob 一个比特 y。两人不能交流，各自回答一个比特 a、b。获胜条件是 a ⊕ b = x ∧ y：只有 x = y = 1 时两人要答得不同，其余三种情况要答得相同。先用经典的答法试试最多能赢多少，再让两人共享 |Φ⁺⟩，各自根据收到的比特选择测量的角度。胜率超过 75% 通关，达到 82% 两星，达到量子力学允许的上限三星。
en: The referee gives Alice a random bit x and Bob a random bit y. They cannot communicate, and each answers with one bit a, b. They win if a ⊕ b = x ∧ y: only when x = y = 1 must the answers differ, in the other three cases they must agree. First see how much classical answers can win at most, then let the two share |Φ⁺⟩ and choose measurement angles according to the bits they receive. A win rate above 75% passes, 82% earns two stars, the limit allowed by quantum mechanics three.

zh: 共享 |Φ⁺⟩ 时，如果 Alice 沿角度 α、Bob 沿角度 β 测量，两人结果相同的概率是 cos²(α − β)。
en: When they share |Φ⁺⟩ and Alice measures at angle α, Bob at angle β, their results agree with probability cos²(α − β).

zh: 你希望三种 (x, y) 的角度差都小，剩下那一种的角度差大。四个角度差的绝对值相等时最好。
en: You want small angle differences for three of the (x, y) cases and a large one for the remaining case. It is best when all four differences have the same absolute value.

zh: 任何经典的做法，包括事先共享随机数，胜率都不超过 75%，这就是 CHSH 形式的 Bell 不等式。量子的最优胜率是 cos²(π/8) ≈ 85.36%，即 Tsirelson 界，对应 CHSH 值 2√2。一组最优的角度：α₀ = 0，α₁ = π/4，β₀ = π/8，β₁ = −π/8。Aspect、Clauser 和 Zeilinger 因为这类实验获得了 2022 年的诺贝尔物理学奖。这里算的是概率；把这组角度交给 ⑮ Bell 游戏里的规则，就能看到一次几百回合的实验里，胜率会在 85% 上下怎样起伏。
en: No classical strategy, shared random numbers included, wins more than 75%: this is the Bell inequality in its CHSH form. The best quantum win rate is cos²(π/8) ≈ 85.36%, the Tsirelson bound, corresponding to a CHSH value of 2√2. One optimal set of angles: α₀ = 0, α₁ = π/4, β₀ = π/8, β₁ = −π/8. Aspect, Clauser and Zeilinger received the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics for experiments of this kind. What is computed here is a probability; hand these angles to the rule in ⑮ Bell game and you see how the win rate of an experiment of a few hundred rounds fluctuates around 85%.

zh: 整体 |Tr(§0§†U)| / §1§（含各列的相对相位）
en: Overall |Tr(§0§†U)| / §1§ (including the relative phases of the columns)

zh: 真炸弹：没爆炸，而且测量结果证明这是真炸弹
en: Live bomb: no explosion, and the result proves it is live

zh: 真炸弹：没爆炸，但结果无法区分
en: Live bomb: no explosion, but the result cannot tell

zh: 电路里没有炸弹门，真炸弹和哑弹的行为完全一样，无从区分。
en: The circuit has no bomb gate, so a live bomb and a dud behave exactly alike and cannot be told apart.
